{{Quote|You can run but cannot walk;<br />''"''You have a mouth but cannot talk;<br />''"''You have a head but never weep;<br />''"''You have a bed but never sleep.|Orphne's riddle|<ref name="Mercy Mission" />}}
'''Orphne''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sentience/Legends|being]] who resided in the [[Aleen Underworld|Underworld]] of [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]].

==Biography==

=== Early life ===
Orphne<ref name=":0" /> was a nymph<ref name="SWE" /> who lived in the [[Aleen Underworld|Underworld]] of [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], deep beneath the surface of the planet.<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> The [[Kindalo/Legends|Kindalo]] species were neighbors of her.<ref name="SWE" /> They knew of her wisdom, but also of her trickster nature.<ref>{{SWE|groups|kindalo|Kindalo}}</ref> As above ground air was toxic to her,<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> she knew of the delicate balance that had to be maintained between the surface and subsurface worlds.<ref name="SWE" /> She presided over a fountain<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> known as [[Orphne's Fountain/Legends|Orphne’s Fountain]], a sophisticated device based on either unknown technology or on the [[The Force/Legends|Force]] itself.<ref name=":1">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

The [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]], unlike the [[Kindalo/Legends|Kindalo]], were not known to have ever had direct contact with Orphne. While galactic records regarding [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] were scant, Orphne had periodic encounters with visitors to the planet dating from the time of first contact. As result, several mentions existed about her, tougth they were frustratingly vague.<ref name=":1" />

=== The Breach ===
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Legends-Date">{{TCWdates|405}}</ref> Orphne was witness to the upsetting of this balance when<ref name="SWE" /> a seal separating the Underworld from the surface world was opened. As result, Orphne and the [[Kindalo/Legends|Kindalo]] began to suffer from the influx of above ground air. Orphene accused the surface-dwelling [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] of causing their suffering and the Kindalo responded to the perceived wrong by causing severe [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]]. The groundquakes caused the death of many Aleena and substantial damage to their infrastructure.<ref name="Mercy Mission" />

[[File:OrphneLounge-SWE.png|thumb|left|250x250px|Orphne lounges in her chair]]
Shortly after [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] arrived on the planet in company with a relief mission launched by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. They fell into the underworld due to one of the groundquakes. Orphne followed them in the form of sparkling dust, causing C-3PO to believe he was under attack. The duo then ran into the Kindalo, who directed them to Orphne after being convinced the two [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were there as friends. The Kindalo claimed that Orphne would help them escape from the Underworld.<ref name="Mercy Mission" />

When they arrived at a large circular chamber, it was revealed that she had been following them in the form of purple and white sparkles. She then attempted to eat C-3PO, but was unable. After her failed attempt at consuming C-3PO Orphne decided to explain to the droids that the Aleena and under-dwellers had made a covenant to separate the above and below ground, so that neither would have to breathe the poisonous air of the other. But somehow, the opening to the underworld had been breached, and the under-dwellers resorted to causing groundquakes in an attempt to resolve their dilemma. After giving a riddle to the two droids Orphne left the room, leaving the droids to their contemplation. R2-D2 quickly devised the answer to Orphne's riddle: river. R2-D2 sprayed water on the water elemental symbol imprinted on the floor, which caused a geyser of water to force the droids out the opening and back to the surface. The two droids then shifted the seal back onto the opening, ending the threat to the residents of the Underworld.<ref name="Mercy Mission" />

=== Legacy ===
The two droids later reported about their encounter with Orphne. They indicated that the Kindalo at least deferred to the riddle-speaking creature and may followed or even worshipped it. This same record also claimed that Orphne could dematerialize at will, taking the form of a shower of lights, so their data was considerated either corrupt or otherwise unreliable.<ref name=":1" />

== Personality and traits ==
Of [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] descent with a quick [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] and a clever wit,<ref name="SWE"/> Orphne was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] creature<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> 1.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> with purple eyes and light green skin. She has three-fingered hands and feet.<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> Neither [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] nor [[Kindalo/Legends|Kindalo]], she belonged to some other, unknown [[Orphne's species/Legends|species]].<ref name=":1" /> She could eject<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> a [[Frog/Legends|frog]]-like<ref name=":0" /> tounge that could extend<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> up to 10 feet.<ref name=":0" /> As a resident of the [[Aleen Underworld/Legends|Underworld]] of [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], above ground air was toxic to her.<ref name="Mercy Mission" />

Orphne was wise to the ways of [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], and understood the importance of keeping both worlds apart.<ref name="SWE" />

==Powers and abilities==
Variously described as “sylphlike” and “magical,”<ref name=":1" /> Orphne had the Force ability to turn herself into a glowing, pink cloud. She could travel freely in this form, and seemed to "unravel" into separate orbs of these glowing particles when transforming into the cloud. This ability was a usage of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that was similar to [[Dathomir Magic|Allyan Magic]].<ref name="Mercy Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orphne made her first appearance on "[[Mercy Mission (episode)|Mercy Mission]]", the fifth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]],<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> aired on [[October 7]], [[2011]].<ref name=":0">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep405|text="Mercy Mission" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> She was voiced by [[Cara Pifko]],<ref name="Mercy Mission" /> who also voiced [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]], [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu Lawquane]], [[Naa'leth/Legends|Naa'leth]] and [[TJ-912/Legends|TJ-912]] in the TV series.<ref>{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref><ref>{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref><ref>{{TCW|Nightsisters}}</ref>

In early artworks by [[Randy Bontag]] Orphne's original design had a less flattened head shape.<ref name=":0" />
